text: Consider the matrix $A=\begin{bmatrix} 5 \amp -1\\ 4 \amp 1 \\ \end{bmatrix} $, whose characteristic equation is $$ \lambda^2 - 6\lambda + 9 = (\lambda-3)^2 = 0. $$ In this case, the characteristic polynomial has one real root, which means that this matrix has a single real eigenvalue, $\lambda = 3$.
